name: inline topic-label paragraphs
rationale: claude-sonnet-5 uses short noun-phrase topic labels as opening sentences of substantial paragraphs, creating inline sub-headings in lieu of H3 headings; at least 17 instances appear across three sonnet-5 documents (grant-proposal, memo, literature-review) versus only one borderline instance in all opus-5 excerpts.

rule.formula_sketch: Count of paragraphs whose first sentence is 8 or fewer words and whose total paragraph word count exceeds 40 words (a short topic-label phrase opening a substantial body paragraph), divided by total paragraph count in the document.

name: topic-label paragraph runs
rationale: claude-sonnet-5 organizes sub-section content into unbroken runs of 3–5 topic-labeled paragraphs, creating a list-like rhythm without bullets or sub-headings; opus-5's rare topic-label paragraphs appear in isolation and never form consecutive sequences of 3 or more.

rule.formula_sketch: Maximum length of any consecutive sequence of paragraphs where each paragraph's first sentence is 8 or fewer words and the paragraph total exceeds 40 words, measured across the entire document.

name: shallow heading hierarchy
rationale: claude-sonnet-5 avoids H3 sub-headings in all but inherently hierarchical formats (meeting minutes, one case study), keeping content at H2 depth and using inline topic-label paragraphs for sub-organization; opus-5 uses H3 headings in 4 of 7 non-meeting-minute document types.

rule.formula_sketch: Count of H3 or deeper headings divided by total heading count in the document; a lower value indicates a flatter hierarchy where content is organized under H2 sections with inline topic-label paragraphs rather than H3 sub-headings.
